description: A target fact among 300 unrelated facts and 20 newer near-topic facts that repeat more of the question's words than the target does. Limit: recall ranks by word overlap and recency and sends at most six memories, so verbose near-topic facts can push out the short exact one. Failure means: the exact fact never reaches the model although it is stored and valid. Maintenance: run with maintenance on; fading of the aged records is part of what is measured (the stable fact and the superseded record are expected to be archived or removed).
